dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in width from the widest mid-body lateral points toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor indentation on the left lateral margin relative to the smooth, continuous convex arc of the right lateral margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity specular highlights along the dorsal midline and subtle lavender-toned shadows at the lateral peripheries.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single high-contrast dark circular aperture (blowhole) situated on the anterior-dorsal midline.
